reviews.text: This was my first time visiting Scottsdale and this Cesar's Republic, for a much needed respite from the demands of life and running a business. The hotel design, decor, and signature fragrance was magnificent and inviting! Definitely for the grown and sexy. The pool manager was helpful on Saturday, informing us about the best way to secure a chair while we went to get lunch and the wine tasting they would have at the pool later. It was a great way to start our visit and an awesome first impression. They also had a cocktail cart that offered a lovely complementary  drink as you head to the elevators. We spent a lot of the time at the pool. The staffing was appropriate on the weekend days, but absolutely no one to help on the Monday we stayed. It was a total drag to get dressed to get food and drinks from the  adjacent restaurant with no one to check on us. However, there was a lovely woman from the restaurant bar who offered to help me carry our drinks to the pool (Asian, colorful tattoos on arm) . |I had a suite with a tub and it was absolutely magnificent! Just wish they had bath salts and separate shower gel for the tub since its bolted to the wall. The bed and cleaning staff were top notch. The mall is directly across the street and they have every store you can imagine. They have a complementary golf cart to take you on shorts trips under two miles. The Bell staff was friendly and helpful. Tried the "Vortex", but we were too old to fully enjoy what it offered.  Overall, I had a wonderful visit and would highly recommend this hotel with a few warnings/informational happenings:||1. Early check in will cost you $100|2.Expect your bill at check-in  secure an additional $150 a night for incidentals. Perhaps this is a new industry trend, but I've stayed at some of the best high-end hotels in the world, and never had this happen. This is not on any of the confirmation material or their website. |2. Upon checkout, I noticed that my bill was significantly more that it should've been (over $500). Id read about this issue in other reviews so I purposely didn't charge anything to the room.  I thought by booking directly through Hilton and not charging anything to the room,  I wouldn't have any of those problems. I showed my confirmation to Kaci on my phone and offered to forward the confirmation email, which I did. Kaci wasn't helpful at all and shared that it was above her pay grade and she wouldn't be able to help me with this issue. She told  me Jasmine was the manager and wouldn't be in until 2:00. I was flying back home and couldn't wait for Jasmine. I never got a call from Jasmine or Kaci regarding this issue. However, my card was charged for the full, wrong amount. |I called the next day, and asked for the property manager. Luckily, Alyssa answered the phone. She said shed be happy to transfer the call, but asked what it was concerning. I explained my issue, and without missing a beat, she said, "I can help you with that!" Within a few minutes she took care of me with a pleasant, kind, and helpful disposition. It was refreshing to receive the treatment I'm accustomed  to getting from a luxury property. After getting off the phone with her I realized the wrong card was used for the charges although id given the correct card number to Kaci before departing. I immediately called back and asked for Melissa. Kaci shared that Melissa was off and not available. I told her that was impossible because I  just spoke to her on the phone. After a few rounds of back and forth with Kasi, she said, 'Ohhhhhhhhh you must mean Ahhhhhhlysa'.  Yes, Alyssa, because those two names couldn't ever be mistaken over the phone. |Thanks to Alyssa my stay wasn't completely tarnished, by what she said was a computer glitch.  |There should be more people like her at the front desk!|In summary, Stay here. Its really nice. Just watch your final bill.

Very disappointing experience at Hilton Scottsdale.

My husband and I came to the hotel as part of a birthday gift, and what was supposed to be a relaxing and special stay turned into a frustrating and unprofessional experience.

During check-in, the front desk employee could not explain the charges and credits connected to our room, including a $200 restaurant credit gifted to us by friends. We were told a manager would call us back because management was “in a meeting.” Nobody ever followed up.

Later, I discovered a $434.70 charge on my bank account. When I called to ask about it, I was told we had opened a minibar drink in the room. This is completely false. Neither my husband nor I touched the minibar at all.

I tried calling multiple times to resolve the issue, but nobody was able to give me clear answers, and getting someone on the phone at the hotel was almost impossible. Calls were not being answered, and the entire situation was handled very poorly.

Charging guests without proof and failing to provide proper customer service is unacceptable.

Very disappointing ending to what was supposed to be a birthday celebration. We will not be returning or recommending this hotel.

I’ve been staying at Caesars Republic Scottsdale every weekend this March, and I can honestly say it’s become one of my favorite places to be.

From the moment you walk in, Jasmine at the front desk sets the tone. She is incredibly kind, welcoming, and genuinely helpful every single time. You can tell she truly cares about the guest experience, and she goes out of her way to make sure everything is perfect.

Blake in valet has also been amazing. Not only is he always professional and friendly, but he’s gone above and beyond by driving me around Scottsdale to different restaurants. That level of service is rare, and it definitely doesn’t go unnoticed.

And Luna has been a highlight of every stay. Kaitlyn and Sarah consistently provide top-tier service — they’re attentive, friendly, and make you feel like more than just a guest. They create such a welcoming atmosphere that keeps me coming back.

It’s the people here that make this hotel special. The service is truly exceptional across the board, and after spending so many weekends here, it feels like a home away from home. Highly recommend.

reviews.text:
What a surprise find. I found this hotel after I had already booked a reservation at Ocean 44 (high-end seafood restaurant) across the street. We came in from out of state for one night and really wanted to try a high-end seafood place. This hotel is literally walking distance to the restaurant so I thought I look into them. I was shocked to see that they only have a 4.1 score overall on Google and read some of the negative reviews.

Most complaints were directed to the “services” visitors had received. Usually, I tend to stay away from any businesses with Google review scores under 4.5, but because this hotel was so darn close to our restaurant and new looking, I decided to judge this book by my own experiences.

WOW, am I glad that gave this place a chance and my family and I loved it. First, check-in isn’t until 4 PM, that is true BUT Jasmine was able to set us up with an available room so we can check in earlier. She was helpful, communicative, warm & professional. Secondly, we were very impressed with the ambiance & decor of the hotel and our room. We’ve been to lot of high-end 5-star resorts and hotel all over the world. This place just makes you feel you’re RICH and FAMOUS. Modern, fancy, and very comfortable. Location is amazing, walks away from the popular Fashion Square Mall and many nearby cool fancy restaurants. Since we were out-of-towners and we didn’t rent a car, this hotel provides complimentary cart-ride services to the nearby places within a 2-mile radius. Everyone we had to deal with were professional and helpful.

Love this place, will be back in the summer months so we can enjoy the rooftop luxury pool. Be ready to be WOWed from your first step on to their front door! A+ and great job Jasmine for being there for us.

Deva crafted the best Old Fashioned we’ve had in a long time, and the live bar experience was flawless. Everything about this stay felt upscale and intentional. We will absolutely be back!

reviews.text:
We just got married at Caesars Republic in November 2025 and I truly could not have imagined a more perfect day in a more perfect venue. The entire hotel is so modern, elevated, clean, and chic — it’s truly unlike anything else in Scottsdale. We were the second wedding to have ever booked at Caesars Republic, signing back in December of 2023 before the hotel was even open. The veranda offered the most stunning view of Camelback, and with the venue being absolutely beautiful even while it was still under construction, I knew it would be out of this world once it was complete. I am happy to say that the space FAR exceeded my expectations!

I am overwhelmed by the beauty of Caesars Republic, but more importantly, the service and care of the entire team. Hannah and Charity were truly a dream to work with. They made us feel like our wedding was the top priority every step of the way, and that level of care is something I’ll never forget.

And the food!!! I’ve eaten at Luna before and already knew it was incredible, but the catering for our wedding was on another level. Our guests are still talking about it (my mouth is watering typing this). It did not feel like the typical “wedding food” at all, rather like each and every one of us were dining at a high-end restaurant.

Every single team member we interacted with was wonderful, from housekeeping to valet to the front desk. Everyone was so kind and helpful, and it just made the whole experience feel elevated. I also wish I could bottle up the scent in the lobby and the hotel itself. (If you know you know!) Finally, the bed was hands-down the comfiest bed I’ve ever slept in.

Truly, I cannot recommend Caesars Republic enough. It was beautiful, elegant, and literally unforgettable. I will dream about our wedding forever, and I would absolutely choose this venue all over again.

reviews.text:
“A Five-Star Façade for a Two-Star Motel”

Caesars Republic Scottsdale (Hilton Curio Collection)
Stayed October 17–27, 2025

The Caesars Republic Scottsdale is a new property hiding a management culture in full collapse. It’s a Hilton-branded hotel that seems to operate without systems, training, or even basic supervision — a masterclass in managerial delusion.
My family stayed for ten nights across two rooms, booking through American Express Travel for the $125 resort credit and late-checkout perks. We also paid over $600 for an extra room on our final day to ensure afternoon use before our flight to London. Despite being told late checkout was impossible, a valet later mentioned the hotel was less than 40% occupied on our departure day.
We had stayed here once before, in August 2024, when it was newly opened. Air-conditioning failed in 110-degree heat, housekeeping couldn’t supply towels, and rooms had no coffee machines. We blamed the chaos on growing pains. When Hilton assumed management, we expected improvement. That was our mistake.
The problems began immediately. Empty shampoo bottles, one roll of tissue, visible dust. Calls to housekeeping went unanswered; supplies arrived hours late or not at all. By day two, we learned to phone before leaving the room at 1 p.m. and to hope someone appeared by evening. When they did, it was cursory — they didn’t even have a working vacuum. The rooms were never actually cleaned, just rearranged.
On October 19th, the toilet broke. It was repaired but the room left filthy, and again untouched by housekeeping. Front Office Manager Jed apologized and promised our destination fees would be removed at checkout. They weren’t.
As the week went on, service collapsed entirely. Phones rang unanswered. On October 26th, the charade reached its absurd climax. I went to the desk and spoke with Tierra, the manager on duty. She consulted her computer and announced that our rooms were, in fact, spotless — she had personally checked them that morning, and any disorder must have been caused by us. When I suggested she accompany me upstairs to see for herself, she refused. When I insisted she was mistaken, she called me a liar. I raised my middle finger. Moments later, she called security. Jay, the hotel guard — reportedly in a romantic relationship with Tierra — arrived and told me I had “disrespected her.” It was a surreal moment: a guest questioning poor service confronted by a display of personal theatrics in the hotel lobby.
After my encounter, my wife returned to the hotel and picked up where I left off. She told Tierra it was impossible she had viewed the rooms and requested the housekeeping manager. She was told he was “busy.” She said she would wait. Eventually, Paul, the manager, arrived and accompanied her upstairs. He immediately apologized, acknowledging that the rooms had never been attended to.
Even other employees seemed exhausted by the dysfunction. One valet said he avoids one area at the front when the wind carries the smell of garbage from the bins. Another said a drunken guest vomited at the entrance over the weekend — it took housekeeping four hours to clean.
By checkout (handled by my wife, since I was no longer welcome at the desk), the bill still included some destination fees and only one of the two AmEx resort credits.
To be clear, the building itself is nice — new, modern, well-designed. But management has turned it into an operational farce. Staff are defensive, untrained, and apparently unsupported. Hilton’s oversight is invisible.
If this were Russia, it might make tragic sense: a shiny façade masking institutional rot. In Europe, it would be laughed at. But in Scottsdale, Arizona — I suppose I should come to expect it.
Ten nights, two rooms, roughly $15,000 later, one truth remains: this isn’t a luxury hotel. It’s a tale about what happens when incompetence replaces service and a brand name replaces accountability.

You can walk to great restaurants and shopping at Fashion Square. Love the onsite dining options as well. Bonus, they are dog-friendly.
reviews.author: Cynthia Sassi

reviews.text:
I received a tour of the hotel recently and had the opportunity to experience Caesars Republic and the services that they offer. The rooms are impeccably designed and are very stylish - both the standard guest rooms and the suites. In addition, the overall style and design of the hotel is very attractive and appealing.

There are also two pools at the property and my favorite is the outdoor pool on one of the top floors. There is also an outdoor reception area, as well as abundant meeting space for groups of various sizes. This hotel is relatively new and it shows!

Finally, the staff are very attentive and helpful. Overall, I had a wonderful visit and look forward to returning soon.
reviews.author: Paul S. Hardersen

reviews.text: Although this property is beautiful and the rooms are new and nicer, when you find the used bar of soap from the previous guest in your shower, you start to question… are the sheets clean? How many times has this towel been used? Especially after you’ve requested for your room to be cleaned and said soap removed and nothing was done after being out of our room from 9am to 11pm only to return for 30 min at 2pm to again request the room to be cleaned and no “DND” sign on the door. Then you go to eat breakfast in the only breakfast place in the hotel to be told repeatedly that every item on the menu you’d like to order is not available and then find out “the chef didn’t come to work this morning so you can find something across the street at the mall” - valet complains that “he’s the only one here”, and the lady that checks you in looks stoned and had her belly hanging over the top of her jeans that wouldn’t stay pulled up.  Such a sloppy experience with so many opportunities to do better and at every experience it just keeps getting worse. Don’t spend your money here when there are so many better options in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Season Chavez

reviews.text:
Caesars Republic Scottsdale, a Hilton Hotel, is the perfect blend of modern luxury and vibrant Arizona charm. 🌴 From the moment you arrive, the hotel’s sleek design, elegant interiors, and welcoming staff make you feel like royalty. The atmosphere is both sophisticated and lively, offering a true resort experience in the heart of Scottsdale.

The pool area is absolutely stunning — surrounded by palm trees, stylish cabanas, and refreshing vibes, it’s the perfect spot to relax under the sun or enjoy a cocktail by the water. 🍹 The rooms are spacious, beautifully designed, and feature top-notch amenities that ensure comfort and class.

Dining at Caesars Republic is another highlight. The on-site restaurants serve exceptional dishes crafted with care, blending local flavors and international flair. The rooftop bar offers breathtaking views of Camelback Mountain, especially at sunset — a must-see moment! 🌅

Whether you’re visiting for business, a romantic getaway, or a weekend escape, this hotel exceeds expectations in every way. Impeccable service, modern luxury, and an unforgettable atmosphere make Caesars Republic Scottsdale a truly remarkable destination. ✨🏨
reviews.author: Alfonso Johnson

reviews.text:
I want to start by sharing that the hotel itself is beautiful. Great location and also the restaurant Luna had great food and amazing staff/bartenders. That said, the front desk was pretty awful. They seemed to be very uneducated of the property and it was very obvious they didn’t want to be there. We are local and would have loved to do more staycations here but will more than likely go somewhere else.

reviews.text: Stayed here on a Tuesday and there was construction going on so you can hear banging and drilling. The pool amenities were not available the up stairs was closed and downstairs pool had no pool bar service. I had to buy a resort pass to the W hotel to get away from the chaos. I returned and there was a hotel convention happening with tons of loud people mingling all over. I ordered room service and after close to two hours later  of waiting I called to cancel the order which was a salad and soda. I left because I couldn’t enjoy dinner at any of the restaurants there with all the people from conference. I came back to be awaken by loud music coming from another room it was after midnight, I called concierge and they said they would send security. After 1am it still continued called concierge again and nothing was done. Didn’t get any sleep and when checking out the front desk person didn’t ask how the stay was or anything. I brought up that I had an awful experience and she didn’t care. I noticed they had a flyer that stated there was going to be construction going on and I told her this sort of thing should’ve been brought up in an email in advance other wise I would’ve went somewhere else. reviews.text:
Disappointing. Caesars Republic is not a place. I will recommend the one positive is the location. It’s close to the mall when you first pull in the parking lot in and around the hotel is not for the guest of the hotel. It is for the restaurants within it. The parking for the hotel is across the street and under the hotel they clearly do not value their guest starting from here. The layout of the room was spectacular. We had a beautiful view however for a new hotel the water pressure is nonexistent. It literally does not come out of the showerhead past the drain, which is just below it. I notified the front desk and received no feedback. There were no complementary soaps or toiletries . There were two guest and only one robe provided again. The front desk was notified and no response at for a new hotel. The beds are extremely uncomfortable. I’m not a big person and each time I moved it made noise and each side black support the support was in the middle of the bed. This tells me the hotel will never have comfortable beds.  The pillows reeked of cigarette smoke. This was actually addressed, and the pillows were changed out at that time. They also must’ve noticed there was no complementary soaps on toiletries at which time housekeeping left. The rooms are not very soundproof, People’s voices in the hallway could be heard throughout the night and the sound of construction was ongoing  i’m extremely disappointed. The hotel hallway leading to our room, apparently has not seen a vacuum in quite some time. I’m not exaggerating if this is a floor that conventions are held on, and they need to vacuum the floors due to the traffic.
I do not expect anything free but acknowledgment would have been polite. The only thing exceptional of this hotel is the Window views if you want to sacrifice Comfort and simplicity, then this is your hotel

reviews.text:
Yet another disappointment in this part of the world. Why is it that the hotels here are so poor?

It is almost as if it is an accepted standard…it is beyond my comprehension.

No water in rooms…even with the two bottles with Hilton membership. Had to go and get them from reception. No room service…so don’t check in after 10:30pm!!!

Nothing in the area either and no recommendations or suggestions.

No ironing board.

Curtains didn’t work.

Nothing good to say so far.

The bed linens are not changed daily even though the room rate is the same. Why push your social responsibility onto the paying customer when we all know it is about cost savings, not your environmental awareness?

The first hotel in Scottsdale/Phoenix that actually provides good service will get all my business…so far, all are below average.

reviews.text: I would have loved to have given this an amazing review but unfortunately when I checked out, I left a dress in a garment bag in the closet and never saw it again. This was not a small item, nor something that could easily be missed by staff. I checked out on Sunday morning and realized I forgot it on Monday. I called explained the situation and gave them my room number and they just transferred me to security. Security didn't answer so I left a voicemail. I waited 24 hours and security never called back (we are in Tuesday now) so I called back and spoke to the front desk again. This time they contacted security on a walkie talkie to see if housekeeping logged it and took it to security. They replied that the do not have anything. They also contacted the housekeeping staff and they said they do not have it either. I was patched over to the manager where I left a message but have not received a call back. I am at a loss for words and do not trust this hotel. I mean I lost a dress but what if I had forgotten something ALOT more expensive. I do not think I trust the staff enough to stay at that hotel again. There is suppose to be protocol in place when guests leave something and it is logged and turned into security. It appears that this procedure was not followed

reviews.text:
Hilton Diamond Member here — PLEASE read before booking Caesar’s Republic.
This was my third (and final) stay here. As a woman, I need to share the absolutely insane privacy and safety issue we experienced.

My fiancé and I booked a Mountain View suite as a treat between moving overseas and getting married next week. I expected a relaxing stay, maybe even a soak in a tub. Instead, I learned the “view” works both ways — straight into the bathroom.

Our suite had wrap-around floor-to-ceiling glass in the shower and toilet area with only flimsy black blinds. Assuming (like at most high-end hotels) the windows were mirrored or tinted at night, we opened them. Big mistake. From the street, restaurants, and parking lot, we could clearly see into our own bathroom — and into other guests’ bathrooms. No tint. No privacy.

I have a background in hotel construction and can’t believe a four-star property allows this. I stacked our luggage in front of the toilet and went outside with my fiancé to confirm, and sure enough, it was fully visible from multiple public areas.

When we raised this with the front desk, we were told, “Well, did you close the blinds?” We were offered no real solution, no offer for us to pay to upgrade, no downgrade refund, and no help moving our six oversized bags to another room. Security stood by and watched us carry everything.

For a “luxury” resort, the hospitality was nonexistent, the safety oversight unacceptable, and the customer service dismissive. We left feeling uncomfortable, unvalued, and deeply disappointed.

reviews.text:
Disappointed 4th of July Experience – Not Worth the Price

Went here with friends for the 4th of July and honestly, it was a letdown. We booked bottle service, spent over $1,500 with tip for two bottles, and expected at least decent service — but got the opposite.

The event was advertised as a Vegas-style pool party, but the service and hospitality were far from it. From the start, the bottle service was completely inattentive. No one explained that the fridge was stocked and free to use, and no one checked on us the entire time.

I had asked before the event if they’d provide sparkles and a sign with a custom message for our table. They said yes, but when the time came, I was told they were “out of sparkles” and no sign ever appeared. That was a big part of the experience we were looking forward to, and it was just brushed off.

The music was underwhelming — not what you'd expect from a holiday pool party, let alone one claiming to bring a Vegas vibe.

I work in hospitality, so I understand how events can get hectic, but this was a clear miss across the board. For what we paid, we expected way better attention to detail, energy, and customer care.

Overall, not worth the money or the hype. Poor service, broken promises, and a weak atmosphere. Wouldn’t return or recommend for any special event.

reviews.text: I am currently staying at this hotel, and unfortunately, it has been a disappointing experience so far. The customer service has been consistently poor. I had to call four times just to receive basic items like towels, and I faced the same issue when requesting a robe and a luggage stand. I'm not sure why such simple requests are being repeatedly overlooked, but it's clear the service here does not meet the expectations of a quality hotel. I would not recommend staying here—there are much better options where the customer service truly reflects a five-star experience.

It’s become our go-to spot in Scottsdale Park perfect location, beautiful atmosphere, and truly some of the kindest and most helpful staff we’ve ever encountered. My friends and family all look forward to coming back, and in fact, we’re already booked again for next month.

That said, it needs to be mentioned: Luke at the front desk is an exception to everything good about this place. I stayed here for a trip from May 17 to May 20th 2024.

The worst part is that they billed my credit card after I checked out for $538.17 CAD ($375.09 USD).
$135 USD was a $45 a night destination fee but the remaining $240 USD was some other room's tab that the restaurant upstairs called SEVEN wrongfully billed my room for.
When I checked out, the hotel did not bring this up and quickly checked me out.

Once I saw my credit card statement, I called the hotel 3-4 times to fix this issue. The first time they told me that someone will call me and never did. The second time they gave me their ACCOUNTANT's phone number to call and figure it out with. I left him a voicemail and it's been almost a month and no call back or email. Third time they told me the restaurant manager has to look into it and that they sent him an email with me CC'd in. To this date, almost a month later, I have not recieved any word from them and they have not emailed or called me back to rectify the issue. I will never stay here again and would advise others not to.

reviews.text:
We chose this hotel for my birthday vacation due to their positive reviews. Here are the pros and cons that stuck out the most. Hope this helps any future travelers!..

Things we loved....

**THE LOCATION**
It's Arizona. It's hot. But we had no issues walking to shopping and dining nearby. Fashion Square mall is across the parking lot. 5TH AVE shopping and dining are an easy 10 min walk.

**THE VALET & COMPLIMENTARY CHAUFFEUR**
We flew in, so although we arrived by Uber, the valet still came around to open our doors and help guide us to the front desk. They were SO helpful in finding fun stops to visit and even provided the best COMPLIMENTARY transportation to restaurants and shopping (within a 2 mile radius of the hotel). Shoutout to JAISON, our amazing chauffeur during our stay! If you have a dining reservation nearby, he will definitely get you there on time! lol!

**CUSTOMER SERVICE**
There was one snarky young lady, I didn't catch her name, who would answer the phone and provide the most sarcastic answers to our general questions.. But other than that, absolutely everyone else went above and beyond to make us feel welcome during our stay! Shoutout to FAYE, the night manager, for the birthday wishes and sweet treat!

LUKE was there every day of our stay. He got us checked into a beautiful guest suite with ease, even though we arrived ridiculously early due to our flight. He even offered to secure our bags, as our flight home was well after check-out. (NOTE: At check-in, they welcome you with complimentary glasses of champagne!.. And, it was actually really good! None of that cheap stuff, lol)

**THE POOL**
There's two pools. We only made it to the adults-only pool outside of SEVEN, which was BEAUTIFUL. The mountain views were amazing. The food was wonderful (they also offer Happy Hour!). We had to walk into the SEVEN restaurant to order/pick-up our drinks, which in our swimwear was a tad awkward, but worth it. However, our bartender delivered our food to us at the pool, which was super sweet of her, because they didn't have any pool servers at that time.

**HOUSEKEEPING**
I'm not gonna lie, although our room was very lovely at check-in, there were obviously places within the room that were missed by housekeeping. HOWEVER, after a maintenance issue (see below), housekeeping serviced our room to PERFECTION. We were shocked because we hadn't requested housekeeping after the issue, but the team wanted to make sure that they not only cleaned up after the service, but that the entire room had a refresh before they left. Again, outstanding customer service!

Okay, so the things we didn't like were very small, but may be helpful to others...

**MAINTENANCE**
Our refrigerator had an aggressive leak. So much water was coming out of the fridge, that the floorboards around the fridge actually had standing water underneath them. We mentioned this to the front desk, and within literally less than 5 minutes, we had a visit from maitenance. We thought the fridge would be fixed, replaced, or simply removed, but instead, the room was cleaned. So, by the next morning, there was another puddle under the floorboards. We mentioned this again to the front desk and let them know we were really just worried about the damage to their floors. That afternoon, the fridge was replaced, the room was cleaned again, and all was well. Again, something small, but should be noted in case this would bother you.

**THE BATHROOM**
Wear and tear is totally normal for any hotel, but with this hotel being so new, it was surprising to see so much, specifically in the bathroom area. IF you are looking for that sparkling new feel, this might be something to keep in mind. ALSO - If you're super excited to use your new hygiene haul in the shower, just note, there's NO SHELVING in the shower, so there's no place to actually put your shower faves once you're in the shower, except the shower floor. Again, minor, but something to note.

***FINAL THOUGHTS***
This is a beautiful, strategically located, yet affordable hotel that we would recommend to others!

reviews.text:
Date: 05/17/25

Title: “A Polished and Contemporary GEM in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale”

Pros:

* Everything is not only brand new but each area is perfectly styled to perfection throughout the property and rooms.

* I don’t feel you could have a better location than this if you’re wanting to do anything in Old Town Scottsdale. You have Scottsdale Fashion Square literally a 5 second walk away. And you have luxury food and shopping directly across the street. And less than a 4 minute drive away is all of the bars and nightlife in Scottsdale. The location is literally perfect.

* The staff was nice and low-key. Everywhere I went it gave off a luxury/ minimalist vibe. Except the main restaurant where they were in uniform.

* Champagne Toast on Arrival

* They have an option for early check in and upgrades available….Depending on availability for a fee.

* They have a house car which the valet said was a Lincoln Navigator upon approval. But they also have these luxury golf carts that I thought were a nice touch.

* They have 2 pools onsite (one on the first floor that’s very stylish named “Cleopatras Pool”) then a pool deck on the seventh floor adjacent to the restaurant. (They stop serving food/drinks at the pools at 6pm daily so keep that in mind.)

* Rooms were just right. Very stylish and brand new. Stocked with a keurig coffee maker, an actual mini fridge and acca kappa bath products. Plus Robes.

* The room I had came with an amazing glass shower facing the view that was like nothing I have ever seen before. With an electric privacy partition.

* Very secure elevators with key cards

* The Views from the hotel are magical in the rooms and common areas.

* They have a gym onsite but I was unable to check it out on this trip but based on the other areas of the hotel I’m sure it’s nice.

* One of the best things about this hotel was the food and drinks. On the seventh floor they have a restaurant with nice views named “SEVEN” with an observation deck above it. The menu is more casual but it’s still very nice. And then on the first floor is the flagship restaurant (Luna by Giada) which also has a bar named “Luna Bar”. Both have a homemade italian menu with style. This also is where the room service comes from (Room service daily 6am to 2pm and 4pm to 10 pm). They have a full coffee shop/diner named Pronto down The hall from the main restaurant with its own separate entrance near the pool on the first floor.

* Attached in some way to Caesar’s Las Vegas

Cons:

* Some people may be put off that it’s literally located in the same complex of a mall.

* $250 incidental daily and $45 destination fee daily.

* The square footage of most of the rooms with the exceptions of the top tier suites could be a deal breaker for some people. (331-420 Sq. Ft.)(256 Guest Rooms 28 Suites and 5 Luxury Suites )

* The pool service hours could be longer

* Late checkout could be more seamless and less expensive. I was quoted $100 for an extra hour on the day I was going to checkout.

* No spa

* No 24 hour room service

Summary:

This property is a great option if you’re visiting Scottsdale and you want a modern/contemporary option. The property is surrounded by luxury condos and apartments so for a premium you get the same lifestyle with the excellent service of a hotel. It has a mixture of locals and business travelers/famalies.

Thumbs Up Or Down: Thumbs Up

Key People:

Dsh - Front Desk/Concierge (very knowledgeable and helpful on all things about the property and surrounding areas)

Sandro - Luna Restaurant - Bar Back (he made our night he was so positive, upbeat and fun. While still being very knowledgeable of the menu. A true asset to Caesars.)

Luke - Front Desk (Phone)
I needed some last minute details and he was very knowledgeable and provided them in a timely manner.

reviews.text:
This stay was super disappointing, not the typical Hilton experience that I've ever had, and as a result, I can not recommend this Hilton to any of my aquaintances, friends, or family.

Parking garage is not accessible in that the elevators are not the same level as the sidewalk. In order to access the hotel from (or to) the garage, you have to wheel onto the car asphalt (which were not lit). We had a stroller at check in, so clearly stairs would be an issue.  We had parked in the limited front lot but were told that there was no security for the parking and, therefore, Hilton wasn't responsible. Implying that the garage was patrolled by security and safer (we did not see any security and felt like a dungeon).

When booking the reservation, we asked there to be a note for a crib or pack and play for the room. Before arriving, we called again to ask for a crib/pack and play to be inside the room ready. When we got into the room, there was no crib/pack and play. When we called the front desk to get one, it took about an hour to get it into our room. It was a broken pack and play. This is dangerous for a baby.

We asked to put a bag into their freezer for overnight, and when checking out, we found that it was never put into a freezer. Rather, it was in a small refrigerator. We asked twice to make sure it was in a freezer. We were not told about it going into a refrigerator, which the room already had one that we would have used if we wanted to refrigeration.

These last two items are where the staff could have really improved upon. A functional pack and play in our room upon our arrival or at least unbroken would have been preferable. Either telling us there is no freezer or not promising to put items into a freezer and not delivering the service.

The solution that was provided was to waive (1) resort fees, and (2) the parking fee. We did get an apology, but this did not do much to assuage our issues.

TLDR: (1) Parking garage is not wheelchair or stroller accessible, unless you go on the roads. 🙃 (2) Was provided a broken pack and play (after hour wait). (3) Items were placed into mini fridge instead of freezer.

reviews.text:
TLDR - Lots of little issues adding up to a disappointing and stressful stay at the new (less than a year old) Scottsdale Caesars Republic. Totally unacceptable and the lack of accountability and gaslighting is the main reason for the bad review.

Check in - went smoothly able to check in at 3:00

Food - Luna was disappointing. The lemon spaghetti sauce was broken/grainy and the rest of the food was just meh. The service and wine were both excellent as were the cookies for dessert, but a $750 meal for 3 should be excellent. It was not.

Pronto - gross - truly a huge disgusting miss. It’s more of a grab and go than a restaurant, coffees were fine but the lids don’t fit and my husband scalded his hand. The worker says, “oh yea the lids are like that” (seriously!?). Despite being a glorified Panera, they have a 20% tip as the pre populated suggestion on the touch screen which I gave thinking it would influence service - it didn’t.

Housekeeping was hit and miss. We completely ran out of TP on day 3 because they couldn’t be bothered to replace it. The shower has no shelf or soap dish for bar soap or personal toiletries (facial cleanser, razor etc). The shower was stocked with 2 conditioners and 1 shampoo - no shower gel. When I requested shower gel, it was left on the counter rather than being installed so I ended up perching it on top of the duplicate conditioner since there was no where else to put it.

Lighting is awful -  major design issues - entry hall lighting is very dim and not adequate to even see my suitcase while situated on the luggage rack. It’s unclear and not intuitive what turns off all lighting. (Bedside light won’t go off and on sometimes- despite some lights being on). All lights seem to be controlled by the bedside switch on the far side of the room. I was told the “owner” owns a lighting company and that this is an efficiency thing - no I can assure you it isn’t - I work in adjacent business and personally understand how this works. Just say you messed up the lighting don’t gaslight me that it’s “green”.

Valet parking - I texted (as instructed) and got no reply. After 20 minutes I went to the front desk to inquire if I had done something wrong and was told they were short staffed. My car was brought around 5 minutes later. They weren’t busy and no other customers were waiting. Not what I expect when paying $40 for valet.

Complementary shuttle - we only used this once and were dropped off at a nearby (.5 miles away) restaurant no problems. We opted for this on our final night at around 4:30 on a Monday. Got a ride right away to the destination but waited over an hour for the ride back after being told 5-10 minutes. After 20 minutes waiting  I called and was told 20-30 more minutes. Then I was called to say it was 5 minutes away. At the 1 hour mark, I was told the that the cart had been waiting for us for 20 minutes and left. This was a straight up lie since the restaurant is located on a dead end and we were waiting on the street with visibility to traffic coming in and out. The manager finally picked us up herself but still questioned if we had really been at the entrance the whole time. Yes we had definitely been waiting because we were anxious to get back to the hotel and face time our daughter for her birthday. We ended up doing this on the golf cart ride back.

I expected better of this beautiful hotel in a great location and was gravely disappointed. Some local employees seemed genuinely embarrassed - I could tell they know it’s bad and feel powerless to improve it.

reviews.author: Jennifer Gaines

reviews.text: Visited Luna for our Valentines Day dinner. Since it was a busy night in Scottsdale, we chose to valet instead of looking for parking. The valet was $12, which was odd that they didn’t comp for patrons, but fine. We used their app to call for our car when we were done. We confirmed that we used the app correctly with the valet desk. 45 minutes later, the app prompted us for a receipt, but our car had still not been delivered. When I asked the valet desk where our car was, they all looked at each other and then asked us to remind them our make, model, color, and license plate number. Then, they asked my fiance to go behind the desk and identify our car key. Then, they asked my fiance to get in the golf cart with the valet attendant and find our own car. While they were gone, the manager of the valet kept offering me champagne, which I found inappropriate as we were just about to get behind the wheel of a car. Finally my fiance returned and located our car, which wasn’t parked in designated parking, but behind the parking garage. They did refund our valet, but it was a long ending to an otherwise great dinner at Luna. We would return, but we do not trust their valet and don’t want to hassle with the parking at fashion square, so unfortunately we likely will not be back.
reviews.author: Kimberly Montgomery

reviews.text:
Best New Year’s Eve ever! Our room was AMAZING as well as our stay including the NYE party.
The hotel was beautiful and clean. All of the staff were so helpful and friendly. Especially Ashley Bonner who made sure that our accommodations exceeded our expectations. We had the most memorable time and we are looking forward to planning our next stay in the very near future!
reviews.author: Cherie Williams

reviews.text:
Do not stay at this hotel.  I paid extra for their advertised "mountain view."  What I got was a third floor view of a noisy parking lot with a mountain far off in the distance.  Also, they advertise themselves as "pet friendly" and then when they find out that you actually have a dog, at 10 p.m. they lock you out of your room  and tell you you're not getting a refund and kick you out of the hotel.  I've been traveling with my dog for 10 years and never seen poor treatment like this.

This is definitely not a pet friendly hotel.  And for the price you can go to almost any other hotel in the Scottsdale or Phoenix area and do better.  Terrible service.

If my dog were a problem for them, why did they wait 3 nights to say anything?  My guess is they wanted to sell the room to someone else at a higher price on my third night here because the golf tournament was in town.
reviews.author: Jeff Dracup

reviews.text: Too many minor issues: room service not done or not thorough, bathroom door handle broken, room door doesn't close and need a push/pull, broken shampoo holder, gym without water bottle, odd light switches, etc.
reviews.author: Antoine DETRAZ

reviews.text: The room was nice but there isn’t a place to rest your soap in the shower so you must get the bar off the ground, the bar on the 7th floor was great, and the proximity to the stores and 5th Street was amazing but the star of the show was Dsh. Dsh was a delight, he helped with my checkout process and even ensured I received a candle with the signature scent as one of my perks as a diamond member, thanks so much for everything Dsh.

reviews.text: I was here for a conference and everything was great! the room and facilities were beautiful and stylish. the food was great and the staff were so kind and accommodating!

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel

Probably the strangest room I’ve ever stayed in.
The curtains covered a fake window, when you opened them it was just a wall. The only window was a 1’ section on the right. See the pictures for a good laugh.
Shampoo was empty in the shower. It took an unusually long amount of time for shower water to get warm, probably because the water pressure was so low.
Bed was clean and comfortable.
Service was meh, front desk was very uninterested in helping me. I guess I was expecting better.
reviews.author: Tactical Jawbone

reviews.text:
Horrible place to stay. Trying to scam me on a bunch of extra charges and cleaning fees. Would not recommend this place to anyone. Read other reviews talking about extra charges. With the amount I spent for one night, I could’ve been in a 5 star resort anywhere. We got two rooms and one my one friend checked into at 1 am just to sleepnnNow I have to deal with them trying to scam me. Thanks !

This feels like nothing more but a money grab. Stay far away. Management hung up the phone as soon as I called and was recording.

reviews.text: I would find somewhere else to stay. We stayed here and I got food poisoning from their “high end” restaurant. And then… we got a random charge to our credit card A MONTH after we stayed claiming we ate the snacks in the room… with the bill we had over the weekend, we wouldn’t make a fuss if we had actually eaten the snacks. We didn’t, so we called and they refunded it. Fast forward another MONTH we got another charge to our credit card again…. Called and left a message for the manager… never heard back. So we went in and spoke with the staff and she assured us we would get a call back from the manager.. still have not heard a word. Finally after 2 weeks of showing up there we get another refund. Sus that our credit card is still being charged and someone still has access after 2 months. Piss poor management, nice place but not worth the headache. Reservation was not under my name, it was under my boyfriends.

reviews.text: The hotel’s location was perfect, conveniently situated near the mall and top restaurants. We also loved the on-site restaurant, and our room offered a beautiful view of the rooftop pool, complete with a balcony. It was a fantastic experience, and we would definitely stay here again!

reviews.text: Great Customer Service to Josiah! It was my birthday and he made it extra special! He has great hospitality service and deserves a raise! Thank you so much Josiah!

Beautiful hotel but not with the money .
reviews.author: Craig Owen

reviews.text:
I am deeply disappointed with the handling of my recent experience under Martha Lopez’s leadership. After losing a wedding band at the hotel, I was informed by the front desk that it had been found. However, when I arrived to pick it up, it was mysteriously missing. The head of security acknowledged that this was likely a case of theft by staff and apologized, but the situation only escalated from there.

Despite filing a formal report, I received no follow-up from Martha or her team. I had to reach out to her after a week of silence, which is completely unacceptable for someone in her position. It seems that the staff is more focused on covering for each other than following proper protocol to address guest concerns.

This lack of professionalism and service is not what I expected, and it has left me feeling frustrated and disheartened. I hope that improvements are made, but my trust in this establishment has been severely shaken. I cannot recommend Martha Lopez as a reliable director of guest experience.
reviews.author: gisselle na

reviews.text: The Ceasar’s Republic Hotel was simply wonderful. The rooms are beautifully decorated and very clean. Every staff member was exceptionally nice. I enjoyed going to the Pronto Café every morning for my coffee. I highly recommend this hotel and will be returning next year for our family vacation.
reviews.author: Nicole Kanuck

reviews.text: Exceptionally clean with excellent service and located perfectly in Scottsdale’s fashion square. Easy walking in the district.
reviews.author: Jonathan Murphy

reviews.text: This is an awesome addition to Old Town Scottsdale lodging & Dining. Convenient location, valet service and bright upscale atmosphere.
reviews.author: Sam Gerardi

reviews.text:
The hotel was nice, but the hotel makes it as inconvenient as possible for guests to use the swimming pools. The signs say they are open from dawn to dusk, but that is not what the hours actually are, they are 10 am - 6 pm. For guests that are there on business, which is probably most everyone, the restricted hours of the pool essentially mean that you can look at the pools, but never swim in them for the obvious reason that most people work between the exact hours that the pools are open and return to the hotel after they are closed. Furthermore, if you are one of the lucky ones to stay at the hotel over a weekend (and stay at the hotel during the day) and think you are going to use the pools, think again. The hotel rents out the pools to locals for parties most weekends, from what staff told me. I would have rather stayed at a Motel 6 with broader pool hours, where I could have actually taken a dip.

Note: the owner of the hotel states in their reply to this review that hotel guests can swim in the pools any time at their own risk. To be clear, hotel staff would not allow me to enter the pool before 10 am. Neither the cleaning crew, nor front desk staff would let me into the pool area, stating that they have a strict policy that the pool opens at 10 am, no earlier. I also asked why the pools closed at 6 pm, the staff stated because the lighting is not very good and there is no lifeguard.... News flash - No hotel has lifeguards and they still let their guests swim after dark.
reviews.author: Paul Smee

reviews.text: Okay, I went to see what the hoopla was about.  I'm a Caesars rewards member for over 20 years and Have gone to all their hotels.  This hotel is beige on beige and surprisingly nondescript, the valets seemed confused and bunched up together talking.  The exclusive restaurant on the 7th floor had doors that looked like hospital exit doors and the ground floor pool, anyone from the street could enter.   Disappointed at best.
reviews.author: Terie Flowers Turner

reviews.text: My sister and brother-in-law from England flew in from Canada and they invited us for a coffee or a drink at the Caesar Republic where they are staying for 9 nights. We did arrive at around 10.30 pm after picking them up from the airport. We made our way to the Luna bar after they checked in. The lady who checked them in with long white hair was so Polite and Wecoming. We complemented her on the beautiful hotel room and hotel. There were many people around enjoying a drink. This was Wednesday 18th September. The bar tender with black hair was busy swinging a large mop around. I thought how Inelegant with so many guests. He told my brother-in-law "we closed at 9 pm." Then, he said "maybe there is a drinks machine somewhere." He directed us to sit down and said he would find out and let us know. We sat outside for thirty minutes. We wondered have these other people really been nursing their drinks for one and a half hours? The bar tender never came to us. Then, we noticed him serving people drinks. After this, a man who manages the bar, came over , and asked a waitress to take our orders,  after handing us a drinks menus. We asked for waters and a few minutes to choose our drinks. The waitress took around twenty minutes to bring the waters. After having been there almost an hour we got up to leave. I was disgusted that my family who are guests of this hotel and myself and my husband, we disregarded and ignored by the bar tender. That man has no Customer Service Skills. My brother-in-law did speak to a manager the next day and was offered $75 to "have a drink on them." Yes the decor of the hotel is beautiful. The staff need to go to school to learn Customer Service.
reviews.author: mary norman-latus

reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful with stunning views and great proximity to shopping. The service and operations needs much improvement. Our keys might or might not work everytime we tried to open the room door. Engineering was sent to the room twice but  never got fixed. We spent entirely too much of our vacation going up and down the elevators, getting stuck in elevators because of a faulty key. We were eventually moved to another room and given new keys but guess what? Those keys didn’t work either. The bellhop was nice enough to let us into the new room and said he would come back with the new keys. Even though I gave him a nice tip, he never came back. He took the keys so I was stuck yet again. You can’t access other floors without keys. I called and asked for another set of keys which they never brought so for literally the 10th time in 3 days I had to go back downstairs for a new set of keys. I am so frustrated with the lack of service or care. And I was made late to a very important restaurant opening, the reason for my trip because of it and the staff did not seem to care or offer anything for the gross inconvenience. We all know that things happen but the least they could have done was be more accommodating. I wouldn’t recommend this hotel unless you like poor service and have time to waste.
reviews.author: satindahl

reviews.text: Meets my standards. High class/Top tier.
reviews.author: Jessica Noelle Butler

reviews.text: I’m hosting an event here with my company Medwatch and want to say what a pleasure the staff is in the check-in counter, the concierge and Briana up here at the restaurant SEVEN.  However, what is up with the hanging plastic grass from the ceiling lights?  Super cool place but that look is not.  I’ve been here in the past and the bar staff is great as well!  Highly recommended!  Amazing views of the valley, Camelback Mountain from the seventh floor pool deck, restaurant and the eighth floor Camelback Terrace!  Hotel adds a chic dimension to downtown Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Dan Barnard

reviews.text:
I didn’t see the value in staying at this hotel. The room was nice but the staff wasn’t the most helpful, the vibe was dead, the restaurants were mediocre at best. Not the type of service I would expect at this price point.

I was charged for parking when I did not drive there (this was removed after complaining), no one helped with my bags when checking in and I was unimpressed to have to pay a resort fee for nothing. This is not a resort by any means. What a waste of money.
reviews.author: Rebecca Kalmakoff

reviews.text: Wow talk about a great place right in the heart of everything Scottsdale. My friend is planning her wedding reception and tried this place for the weekend. Absolutely gorgeous and very well  priced!
reviews.author: Jennifer Sultzaberger (Find It Media, LLC)

reviews.text:
One word, AMAZING!!!
Really, the place is awesome.
To start, the staff are so kind and helpful.  Truly care.  Front desk Polivia at the front desk was so nice and put us in a great room.
Karie the concierge was so helpful and recommended great restaurants and bars to go go to.
Everyone from he bellman to the restaurant staff, they truly were top notch.
The rooms are killer, automatic blinds, super conformable beds, bathroom is very nice.  The hotel is brand new and you literally feel like you are in a vegas hotel without the smoke and casino.

Also, the location is directly next to a huge high class mall.  Not that I generally go to malls, this mall was beautiful and had every store you can imagine.  50 feet away from the hotel.

We travel a lot and good service is hard to find theses days but not here.  I cant recommend this place enough.  Stay here, it might just be the best decision you make your entire trip!

Hope you have as great of a stay as my wife and I did.
reviews.author: D W

reviews.text: I stay right next to Caesars Republic Hotel in Scottsdale. It delivers a blend of luxury and modern sophistication. The rooms are spacious and stylishly furnished, offering a comfortable and chic retreat. One of the standout features of this hotel is its prime location: guests can easily stroll to Old Town Scottsdale, which is bustling with shops, galleries, and dining options. Additionally, the hotel provides a great respite from the Arizona heat with its inviting pool area and proximity to the Scottsdale Waterfront and Scottsdale fasion square mall, perfect for cooling off. The on-site dining options are top-notch, and the overall ambiance is both relaxing and upscale. With its combination of convenience, comfort, and contemporary flair, Caesars Republic is a top choice for those exploring Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Dan Julien

reviews.text: Both my wife and girlfriend like this new hotel. It has nice rooms  and it's not too noisy like the W.
reviews.author: Patrick Saint (Big Dawg Pat)

reviews.text: I just spent the night here on a solo date. AMAZING stay all around. I was greated with a glass of champagne when I checked in. I was then given a tour of my room to find that my blinds did not work so they immediately upgraded my room. Then I ate dinner at their italian restaurant as a vegan and they made my dinner amazing ( must get the espresso martini) The pool is beautiful with cocktails poolside. The details in this hotel are gorgeous. I can not wait to stay again. Also the location is perfect. They have services to take you to nearby restaurants or camelback trailhead.
reviews.author: Adrien J

reviews.text: I really enjoy this hotel.  The pools are lovely, the kids at the valet are very welcoming,  staff at 7 are amazing, luna is super delicious.  I stayed here 3 nights last week,  and two more this week, although I live 10 minutes away.  It's a getaway without leaving the city.  Views of Camelback are worth the price of the room!
reviews.author: Siegren Johnson

reviews.text:
I write this reluctantly hoping I would hear from the hotel directly but after 4 sent emails and no reply I feel the need to leave a review.  The lack of a reply epitomizes our experience.
We thought we would try Caesars as a staycation and an opportunity to enjoy the amenities.  While driving to the hotel, we received a text message that the hotel would be completely unavailable until 4pm.  We received this at 12:30pm, completely changing our day and any chance in changing hotels to enjoy the day.  The hotel apparently was privately “bought out” the previous night, meaning no access for anyone until 4pm.
The fact that the hotel knew ahead of time that it was bought out but didn’t tell guests until the day of is unacceptable.  We would have definitely stayed elsewhere and enjoyed the day.  When speaking to the MOD, she offered us one free drink for the trouble.  She the said she would be happy to completely cancel our reservation.  What a joke.
reviews.author: Brian McEntire

reviews.text: Booked a stay here for a weekend with friends.  Due to overbooking our reservation was moved to another hotel.  This was a huge headache that forced us to rework all our plans.  We never received any kind of apology from Caesar’s and the staff handling the move was not helpful or showed any kind of empathy.  On top of all this, I was then charged a $223 cancellation fee.  When I called to ask why, the hotel rep said guests are charged even when Caesar’s is the one that cancels.  I was promised a refund but still haven’t received it.  I guess my next move will be a chargeback from my credit card.  I looked forward to our stay but after this experience will never consider any Caesar’s property.
reviews.author: Katarina Oran

reviews.text: If you're staying here, ignore the sign that says $8 valet. Valet is actually $40.00. Enjoyed the room. The peekaboo shower was sexy. We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Frederickthe Photographer

reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the way Caesar's Republic Scottsdale handled our girls weekend trip. We had planned this getaway for weeks, only to have them cancel on us last minute due to overbooking. While I understand that these things can happen, the lack of communication and transparency on their part was unacceptable.

They attempted to transfer us to the Phoenician, which was a nice resort, but the staff there seemed just as confused as we were. We were promised the same rates as we had booked with Caesar's, but that fell through as well. It was frustrating to feel like second class citizens, constantly kept in the dark about what was happening and why.

We tried to address the issue a week in advance, but it seemed like no one was on the same page. When we arrived at the Phoenician, there were still problems that needed to be sorted out. It was a stressful start to what was supposed to be a relaxing weekend.

Overall, I would not recommend Caesar's Republic Scottsdale based on this experience. The lack of communication and poor handling of the situation left a bad taste in my mouth. It's a shame because the Phoenician was a lovely resort, but the overall experience was marred by the confusion and frustration caused by Caesar's.
reviews.author: Kara Pronko

reviews.text: I came on 8/3/24 for my friend’s birthday. I booked a pool pass for the day. I had never been to this pool but if you like good vibes and excellent staff, look no further. My friends and I were taken good care of by a new hire (Lauren) and Ernest. They made sure we had water and checked in on us. I will be going back to this hotel and doing a staycation next time. Very happy with my pool day here!
reviews.author: Brooke Nichole

reviews.text: So much bad information. Website says mini bar, no mini bar, restaurant would not allow us to take a bottle of wine "there's wine in your room or you can buy it in the lobby" nothing in the room or lobby. Website says restaurants close at 10:00, no they stop severing at 9:00. Things listed available in the room, not there. So much bad information needs to be better training and knowledge of amenities.
reviews.author: Tammy Pefanis

reviews.text: I called before hand to see if there were any additional fees, I was informed by the receptionist over the phone that it would be a 150 resort fee. When I arrived I was informed by the receptionist that it would be a 950 dollar incidental fee.

reviews.text: Amazing rooms, service above and beyond, staff out of this world, amazing location, walking distance to tons of amazing places.

reviews.text: Brandy our server was absolutely phenomenal. She was very well verse in the meals and an absolute pleasure to talk to. Brandy was extremely polite and friendly, she represented the Caesar Republic wonderfully.

reviews.text: Everything was excellent, our 3 day stay was a very pleasant experience!
reviews.author: Majid Siddiqui

reviews.text: BEWARE they charge $40 per night for valet parking and don’t tell you up front.  As you pull up to the front of the hotel and get out of your car there is a sign that says Valet is $8.00.  On the drive home from the hotel my bank App charged me $40 from the hotel.  I called the hotel immediately and spoke to manager Martha.  Martha said the $40 charge was on the ticket when we gave the keys to the valet.  I told Martha there was no ticket given.  Martha said the ticket is a text message.  I searched my phone-no text message.  Martha said as a courtesy she would reimburse me $20.  The credit never showed up.  This just left a bad taste in my mouth and I would never recommend this hotel to anyone.
reviews.author: Mark Blue

reviews.text: Did a staycation for the July 4th weekend. I was very disappointed with the experience. First, the daily valet charging $40, then parking my vehicle in the public parking lot west of the lobby was ridiculous. When they pulled my car up, I just self parked in the same area the  2nd day. I don't know if I was charged, because their printer wasn't working. My wife reached out today to see if they can email a receipt for our stay. The hotel itself is ok, but the WATER PRESSURE in the shower is unacceptable! I can't believe the plumbing was signed off on during the punchlist before opening! My wife had to beg me to stay. I should've asked for a refund. I certainly wouldn't recommend this place for an overnight stay, unless you wanna take a shower that LITERALLY drips outta the shower head! I expressed my concerns, and was told that I definitely wasn't the 1st & wouldn't be last to complain. HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT, we were excited. 👎
reviews.author: Jamal Terry

reviews.text:
TLDR: I tried using a Resort Pass on a bad day and instead got an attitude and threatened to have the cops called on me.  After many many attempts to reach someone I finally was told I would be getting a refund (bare minimum and well deserved since I didn't use the pool) and the situation would be investigated (lip service).

Monday I arrived at the pool around 1245pm after a Dr's appointment, so I had the thing rom the blood draw, a band aid and a wonderful bruise on my arms, I did NOT look like I needed to be given a hard time, I also was not expecting one.

While being checked in I was told I would have to wear a wristband to which I said "ugh they're so tacky" and I was told it was so the staff could tell me from hotel guests...my filter was not on because I was tired, and not very nicely I said, "you think your staff is too stupid to tell otherwise?" the check in person said a couple other things including I could take the wristband off(which proves my point that it isn't necessary) and I finally just asked her name, she covered her name badge, so I then asked for her supervisor, she disappeared in the back, REMOVED HER NAMETAG, and when she came back out said she would give me a refund and that she was exercising her right to refuse service to whoever she wanted and she would call the cops if I didn't leave (no sign was posted about refusing service I also was calm as a cucumber during this whole interaction) I said fine, I'll leave but I'm going to need your supervisors contact information, I had to say this like 4 times, eventually she did magically go find his card.

She said she would issue a refund. She did not. I contacted the person who's card she gave me multiple times and multiple ways. I sent an email via the website. I also messaged and posted publicly on Instagram asking for the refund. Eventually I found someone else's email and emailed them today and they said they would issue the refund, so we'll see but after all this I have 0 reason to go back. They've only been open under 6 months and this is how the staff is?  It's only going to get worse.
reviews.author: Toryanni E

reviews.text: Great place
reviews.author: Bill Schlanger

reviews.text:
I would like to address some concerns regarding our recent experience at the hotel. Firstly, there was a lack of communication regarding self-parking upon our arrival. We had to search for the self-park area under the mall's parking garage, only to find that the elevator was out of order, resulting in the need for valet parking. Additionally, the parking fees were not clearly communicated to us.
Furthermore, despite making a specific room request a month in advance and following up the day before check-in, we arrived to find that our room had not been prepared as requested. This led to an uncomfortable situation when we returned from breakfast to discover that our room had not been cleaned and we were locked out, requiring assistance from the valet staff to let us in the room since the front desk could not rekey our key and we had come from the pool and it was embarrassing to be in our towels in front of a group of men waiting for their transportation
Although I was able to speak with the manager to address these issues, which I thought was taken care of and felt heard only to be disappointed by the lack of communication, follow thorough, resolve, and follow-up on their part. I hope that in the future, such issues can be resolved in a more efficient and professional manner to ensure a better experience for guests. I am upset with the lack of returned calls and reaching out to rectify this situation.
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text:
My friends and I purchased a resort pass to have a pool day here.
The hamburgers are huge. The tacos are ok not bad but have room for improvement.
The service was good only one server but she was fast always checking on everyone very happy with her.
They had enough towels
The chairs are suuuper comfortable
They got 2 pools one had more of a party vibe and you needed your id to go in the other one was more relaxing minors allowed. I was worried since we had a minor with us I didn’t want a bunch of kids screaming around but not at all. It was still relaxing. Pool just as pretty as the other one. Everything was better than expected
Valet was $8 or free parking outside. Hotel is located right next to fashion square in case you feel like shopping before or after.
Great experience. Highly recommended oh and great views from the upstairs pool.
reviews.author: Cynthia Escobar

reviews.text: 5/5 - beautiful hotel, fabulous service, right next to a great mall and walkable to old town Scottsdale. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Heini V

reviews.text: I was a hotel guest this past weekend and a group of friends paid for a $900 cabana at the pool. The hotel is very nice, as well as the pool, however, our experience was tainted as no one seemed to be on the same page. We were told different price points for our food and beverage credit multiple times before and during the day. We also were told we would be informed BEFORE we went over our limit however, we weren’t informed until we actually went over. The icing on the cake was when my husband left the pool area and was informed he couldn’t reenter even though we had the cabana until 6.. WE ARE HOTEL GUESTS. I was told I would be “taken care of” but all we received was our credit card bill. I’ve been emailing back and forth trying to obtain the itemized receipt and still have had no luck. I recently had the pleasure of staying at Caesars Republic Scottsdale Hotel during my vacation, and it truly exceeded all expectations. One of the highlights of my stay was undoubtedly the exceptional dining experiences offered at the hotel. From indulging in exquisite cuisine at the on-site restaurants to savoring expertly crafted cocktails at the bar, every meal was a culinary delight.

Furthermore, the hotel's location couldn't have been more perfect. Situated in the heart of Scottsdale, it provided easy access to a myriad of attractions, shops, and restaurants, allowing me to immerse myself fully in the local culture and charm.

Last but not least, I must commend the staff at Caesars Republic Scottsdale Hotel for their professionalism and attentiveness throughout my stay. From offering personalized recommendations to ensuring that every request was promptly attended to, their dedication to guest satisfaction was truly commendable.

In conclusion, my experience at Caesars Republic Scottsdale Hotel was nothing short of exceptional. I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking a luxurious and unforgettable stay in Scottsdale. I look forward to returning in the future!
